bibliography.title: Visual Planning: Let's Think Only with Images

sections.title: 3 Experiments and Results: Tasks, Models, Evaluation Metrics
A Use of Large Language Models

abstract_sentences.text: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) and their multimodal extensions (MLLMs) have substantially enhanced machine reasoning across diverse tasks.

evidence.anchor: enhanced machine reasoning across diverse tasks

abstract_sentences.text: However, these models predominantly rely on pure text as the medium for both expressing and structuring reasoning, even when visual information is present.

evidence.anchor: predominantly rely on pure text

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we argue that language may not always be the most natural or effective modality for reasoning, particularly in tasks involving spatial and geometrical information.

evidence.anchor: language may not always be the most natural or effective modality

abstract_sentences.text: Motivated by this, we propose a new paradigm, Visual Planning, which enables planning through purely visual representations for these “vision-first” tasks, as a supplementary channel to language-based reasoning.

evidence.anchor: we propose a new paradigm, Visual Planning

abstract_sentences.text: In this paradigm, planning is executed via sequences of images that encode step-by-step inference in the visual domain, akin to how humans sketch or visualize future actions.

evidence.anchor: planning is executed via sequences of images

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce a novel reinforcement learning framework, Visual Planning via Reinforcement Learning (VPRL), empowered by GRPO for post-training large vision models, leading to substantial improvements in planning in a selection of representative visual navigation tasks, FROZEN LAKE, MAZE, and MINI BEHAVIOR.

evidence.anchor: VPRL ... empowered by GRPO

abstract_sentences.text: Our visual planning paradigm outperforms all other planning variants that conduct reasoning in the text-only space.

evidence.anchor: outperforms all other planning variants

abstract_sentences.text: Our results establish Visual Planning as a viable and promising supplement to language-based reasoning, opening new avenues for tasks that benefit from intuitive, image-based inference.

evidence.anchor: viable and promising supplement to language-based reasoning

final_judgment.single_storyline: 对空间/几何状态转移，连续图像比语言更直接地承载中间规划；Stage 1 先建立可解析且可探索的视觉状态转移，Stage 2 用 validity + progress reward 和 GRPO 形成目标导向规划。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: Figure 1–2、五个编号公式、任务/模型/EM-PR 定义、Table 1–2、Figure 3–6、27% EM、difficulty 曲线、error analysis、exploration 与 invalid-failure ratio。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 数据统计与 leakage split、IoU/MSE/BFS parser、超参数、prompts、OOD、Stage 1/2、失败轨迹、tokenizer reconstruction 与 token cost 移入 Appendix A–G；正文可讲清主线，但复现、外推和成本边界依赖附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 同一输入并列三种推理媒介的 Figure 1、image pair→interpreter→reward→policy update 的 Figure 2、跨任务分项与平均 EM/PR 的 Table 1，以及 Stage 1/2 数字化拆解的 Table 10，形成接口—机制—结果链。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 摘要/结论的 outperforms all、generalization 与 feasible 超出三项 synthetic grid tasks；OOD absolute EM、规则 interpreter、token-only cost、定性 masking 和单案例机制解释限制了外推与因果闭合。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 新推理媒介应先用同一输入的媒介对照图建立接口差异，再用阶段/组件对照分开中间机制与最终指标，并在主表同时给跨任务分项和聚合值。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于状态转移可由图像直接验证且存在明确 progress/validity 判定的视觉规划；开放语义、不可由差分可靠解析的动作或 wall-clock 优化场景需要额外 validator、真实资源测量和跨域任务。
